src_sentence: According to findings, Singaporeans are among the biggest spenders on Valentine's Day, with 60% of Singaporeans indicating that they would spend between $100 and $500 during the season leading up to the holiday.

src_sentence: In the United States, the first mass-produced Valentines of embossed paper lace were produced and sold shortly after 1847 by Esther Howland (1828–1904) of Worcester, Massachusetts.
translation: Nos Estados Unidos, os primeiros cartões de Dia dos Namorados produzidos em massa de papel rendilhado em relevo foram produzidos e vendidos pouco depois de 1847 por Esther Howland (1828–1904) de Worcester (Massachusetts).

src_sentence: In recent years, Romania has also started celebrating Valentine's Day. This has drawn backlash from several groups, institutions, and nationalist organizations like Noua Dreaptă, who condemn Valentine's Day for being superficial, commercialist, and imported Western kitsch.
translation: Nos últimos anos, a Romênia também começou a celebrar o Dia dos Namorados. Isso gerou reações negativas de vários grupos, instituições e organizações nacionalistas como a Nova Direita (Romênia), que condena o Dia dos Namorados por ser superficial, mercantilista e um Kitsch ocidental importado.

src_sentence: There are a number of martyrdom stories associated with various Saint Valentines connected to February 14, including an account of the imprisonment of Saint Valentine of Rome for ministering to Christians persecuted under the Roman Empire in the third century.
translation: Há uma série de histórias de martírio associadas a vários santos valentins conectados a 14 de fevereiro, incluindo um relato da prisão do Valentim de Roma por ministrar aos cristãos sob a Perseguição aos cristãos no Império Romano no século III.

src_sentence: A proverb says that "Saint Valentine brings the keys of roots".
translation: Um provérbio diz que "o São Valentim traz as chaves das raízes".

src_sentence: The only public celebration in Poland is held annually from 2002 in Chełmno under the name "Walentynki Chełmińskie" (Chełmno Valentine's).

src_sentence: Valentine of Terni became bishop of Interamna (now Terni, in central Italy) and is said to have been martyred during the persecution under Emperor Aurelian in 273. He is buried on the Via Flaminia, but in a different location from Valentine of Rome.
translation: Valentim de Terni tornou-se bispo de Interamna (agora Terni, no centro da Itália) e diz-se que foi martirizado durante a perseguição sob o imperador Aureliano em 273. Ele está sepultado na Via Flamínia, mas em um local diferente do Valentim de Roma.

src_sentence: According to The Hindu in February 2023, the Animal Welfare Board of India appealed to Indians to celebrate February 14 as "Cow Hug Day" for "emotional richness" and to increase "individual and collective happiness."

src_sentence: It is claimed that as a result of Valentine's Day, the working classes and rural poor become more disconnected socially, politically, and geographically from the hegemonic capitalist power structure.
translation: Afirma-se que, como resultado do Dia dos Namorados, a Classe trabalhadora e os pobres rurais tornam-se mais desconectados social, política e geograficamente da estrutura de poder capitalista hegemônica.

src_sentence: A previous failed attempt to popularize this celebration had been done by a marshmallow manufacturer who wanted men to return marshmallows to women.

src_sentence: It was a rite connected to purification and health, and had only slight connection to fertility (as a part of health) and none to love.

src_sentence: In 1835, 60,000 Valentine cards were sent by post in the United Kingdom, despite postage being expensive.
translation: Em 1835, 60.000 cartões de Dia dos Namorados foram enviados pelo correio no Reino Unido, apesar de o porte postal ser caro.

src_sentence: In the 1969 revision of the Roman Catholic Calendar of Saints, the feast day of Saint Valentine on February 14 was relegated from the General Roman Calendar to particular (local or even national) calendars for the following reason: "Though the memorial of Saint Valentine is ancient, it is left to particular calendars, since, apart from his name, nothing is known of Saint Valentine except that he was buried on the Via Flaminia on February 14."
translation: Na revisão de 1969 do Calendário Romano Geral, o dia festivo de São Valentim em 14 de fevereiro foi rebaixado do Calendário Romano Geral para calendários particulares (locais ou mesmo nacionais) pela seguinte razão: "Embora a memória de São Valentim seja antiga, ela é deixada para calendários particulares, uma vez que, além de seu nome, nada se sabe sobre São Valentim, exceto que ele foi sepultado na Via Flamínia em 14 de fevereiro."
